basic_info.description:
Welcome to this exceptional corner unit on the third floor of the highly sought-after 300 Ivy building in Hayes Valley. With modern design, premium finishes, and unbeatable convenience, this two-bedroom, two-bathroom condo is perfect for those seeking a sophisticated and comfortable urban lifestyle.

Key Features:
- Prime Corner Unit: Enjoy abundant natural light and privacy in this third-floor, south west-facing gem. 
- High-End Appliances: Outfitted with a Bosch and Liebherr appliances, including stovetop, oven, refrigerator, dishwasher, and in-unit washer-dryer for a truly luxurious living experience.
- Secured Parking: Includes a dedicated car parking space in a secure garage and secured bike parking.
- Modern Comforts: Features in-unit heating and cooling, double-pane floor-to- ceiling windows for noise insulation, and high-quality finishes throughout.
- Shared Amenities: Access to a beautifully landscaped rooftop with BBQ, stunning views and pet potty patch, perfect for relaxation or entertaining.

Unbeatable Location:
- Hayes Valley at Your Doorstep: Just one block from the vibrant shops, restaurants, and cafes of Hayes Street.
- Convenient Transit: Close to multiple Muni bus line, tech shuttles and Muni Metro's Van Ness station for easy access across the city.
- Cultural Hub: Steps away from San Francisco's finest performing arts, including the opera, symphony, SFJazz, and City Arts & Lectures.

Building Perks:
- On-site weekday tenant concierge for convenience and security.
- Secure mail area and package locker box. 
- Lush landscaping creates a serene and welcoming atmosphere.

Details:
- Monthly Rent: $5,800
- Security Deposit: $5,800
- Lease Term: 12 months
- Tenant responsible for building move in/out deposit

Don't miss your chance to live in one of San Francisco's most desirable neighborhoods in a home that combines luxury, comfort, and convenience.

Schedule a Showing:
For more information or to schedule a showing, contact via Zillow.

Tenant responsible for gas and electricity. No smoking in the unit or building. One-year lease.
